**Finding submitted: deviation (AUDIT).**

- The agreement contains no audit clause as such; the operative inspection hook against us is § 11.3 (p0132), where IBM "reserves the right to investigate potential violations" of our AUP warranty, plus p0138 requiring us to provide "all relevant information" on IBM's request.
- As drafted this right is unlimited in frequency, unannounced (the p0137 notice applies only before IBM restricts access or removes Content), silent on cost, silent on confidentiality/independent auditor, and does not bar system access — failing the fallback (once per year, 15 days' notice, Vendor cost unless >10% underpayment) and edging into walk-away territory.
- Redline validated (ok:true): a single inserted 11.3(e) adding once-per-12-months, 30 days' notice, business hours, independent auditor under confidentiality, IBM's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct/remote system access with off-site review — preserving IBM's emergency and legal-requirement carve-out, with the 15-day/10% fallback offered in the comment.
